correctness.rationale: Direct characteristic-two substitution proves that unital endomorphisms are exactly arbitrary choices of n nilpotent generator images. An invertible cotangent matrix is equivalent to an automorphism. Every idempotent is conjugate to a unique coordinate projection by choosing fixed and killed generator lifts. The stabilizer count has GL_r and GL_(n-r) blocks and independently selectable higher coefficients, giving the exact rank formula. The bounded Gaussian-binomial factor and computed adjacent logarithmic differences prove concentration for n>=64. Independent complete enumeration gives n=2 over q=2: [1,12,1], q=4: [1,80,1]; n=3 over q=2: [1,448,3584,1]. Risks: finite tests cover only these sizes; generality rests on supplied argument, not numerical extrapolation.

value.rationale: Idempotent multiplicative self-maps are algebra splittings, and both image dimension and cotangent dimension are canonical numerical invariants. The theorem enumerates all of them on the complete-intersection/group algebra of elementary abelian two-groups, for every n and even q. It proves a non-obvious logarithmic typical loss of cotangent generators, a sharply different image fraction of order 1/n, and superexponential tails. This is a natural complete classification with asymptotic information, not a small table or an arbitrary slice. Risks: specific to characteristic two and subject to independent mathematical assessment.
